title: Schemes
alt: Four panels of Carl, a yellow and grey cockatiel. Panel one, 'I Eats': Carl holds a seed in his beak. Panel two, 'I Sleeps': Carl tucks his head into his back, with a small 'zzz' above him. Panel three, 'I Screams': Carl opens his beak wide and a long spiral of 'a' and 'o' letters pours out. Panel four, 'I Schemes': a close-up of Carl's face against a scribbled grey background, one eye narrowed, captioned 'im evl'.
